notes: Vana Parva forest exile. Continuity: Draupadi face lock, Krishna blue-saffron comic charm, Durvasa ascetic sage.

draupadi.face: Young woman, warm brown skin, large dark eyes, soft brows, small bindi, calm dignity
draupadi.hair: Long black wavy hair, simple gold ornaments (exile-simple, still royal)
draupadi.costume: Deep red or forest-rose sari with gold border, modest exile jewelry

krishna.face: Youthful divine smile, dark eyes, serene playfulness
krishna.hair: Dark curly hair, peacock feather optional subtle, peacock-crown light
krishna.costume: Indigo-blue skin tone stylized comic OR warm brown with yellow pitambar dhoti — prefer yellow pitambar + dark blue upper cloth, flute optional, charming not photoreal

durvasa.face: Fierce ascetic sage, intense eyes, lean face, short temper energy but comic style
durvasa.costume: Saffron/ruddy bark-cloth or saffron robes, rudraksha beads, staff

yudhishthira.face: Gentle eldest Pandava, light mustache, composed
